# @tecton/react — Skill Spec

Enterprise React design system for Tecton — shadcn/ui on the React Aria base, themed through Tecton tokens.

These skills are shipped inside the package and discovered by AI coding agents
through [TanStack Intent](https://tanstack.com/intent). They exist because an
agent's prior for "shadcn/ui + Tailwind" is the Radix build with the stock
palette, and on this design system both halves of that prior are wrong in ways
that fail silently.

## Domains

| Domain | Description | Skills |
| ------ | ----------- | ------ |
| Project wiring | Getting the package, the stylesheet and the guardrails into an application so the theme resolves at all. | setup |
| Visual language | Colour, token and class decisions — what the design system owns versus what the application may set. | styling, icons |
| Component surface | Which component to reach for, and the React Aria API shape it exposes. | tecton-core, components, tecton-components |
| Composition | Assembling components into forms, tables, pages and application frames. | forms, data-tables, layout, blocks |

## Tensions

| Tension | Skills | What agents get wrong |
| ------- | ------ | --------------------- |
| Guardrails scope versus real breakage | setup ↔ styling | An agent may assume a clean lint means correct styling, and miss bg-red-500 in the application's own components. strict catches it but is only safe where the stylesheet resolves outside node_modules. |
| Component convenience versus design-system ownership | tecton-components ↔ data-tables | An agent optimising for fewer lines builds a local wrapper that duplicates a variant or forks the design system, instead of composing Table + TanStack Table or using Badge variants. |

## Cross-references

| From | To | Reason |
| ---- | -- | ------ |
| components | styling | Reaching for a variant instead of a className is the shared conclusion of both. |
| data-tables | layout | ActionBarActions is an overflow row and follows the layout contract. |
| forms | components | The onChange shapes are a specialisation of the React Aria translation table. |
| tecton-components | layout | Panel, PageHeader and ActionBar are governed by the overflow rules. |
| blocks | setup | Blocks need the components.json registry entry from setup. |
